candidate_sentence_map.S1: Trophy Games reported strong financial results for fiscal year 2025, marked by accelerated revenue growth and record quarterly profitability.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Total revenue increased by 40% to DKK 126,523 thousand, up from DKK 90,070 thousand in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: EBITDA rose 26% to DKK 31,117 thousand, while profit before tax more than doubled by 109% to DKK 19,013 thousand, yielding an EBT margin of 15%.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Profit for the year reached DKK 12,539 thousand, reflecting a 20% return on equity and basic earnings per share of DKK 0.47.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: The solvency ratio stood at 78%, supported by a debt-free capital structure.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Revenue expansion was primarily driven by the scaling of the Transport Series portfolio.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: The flagship titles Airline Manager, Truck Manager, and Farm Manager collectively accounted for 67% of total revenue, up from 35% in the prior year.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Airline Manager contributed DKK 37,787 thousand, Truck Manager generated DKK 25,181 thousand after its late 2024 launch, and Farm Manager added DKK 22,002 thousand within six months.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Revenue from older transport titles declined 46% to DKK 20,955 thousand as marketing resources reallocated toward the core portfolio.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Margins benefited from a strategic shift toward in-app advertising, which doubled to DKK 18,476 thousand and avoids standard platform fees.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: To sustain growth, marketing expenditures increased 76% to DKK 40,486 thousand, targeting titles with rapid payback periods.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Although elevated marketing spend compressed the EBITDA margin to 25% from 27% in 2024, underlying profitability remained stable once the DKK 4,918 thousand in non-recurring impairment charges from 2024 are excluded.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: The fourth quarter delivered the strongest results in company history, with revenue jumping 106% to DKK 40,959 thousand and profit before tax reaching DKK 10,120 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Additional financial adjustments included a DKK 4.7 million repayment of historical R&D tax credits following a Danish tax reassessment, and the completion of a DKK 4.89 million share buyback program.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Management attributes the performance to disciplined execution in a mature mobile gaming environment, utilizing data-driven user acquisition and refined ad monetization.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: For 2026, the company guides for revenue between DKK 130 million and DKK 153 million and EBITDA ranging from DKK 28 million to DKK 36 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: This forecast incorporates projected advertising income of DKK 22 million to DKK 27 million, a planned marketing budget of DKK 45 million to DKK 50 million, and sustained development investments in upcoming titles including Train Manager 2 and Space Manager.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, and K5 are all PRESENT with clear evidence in the candidate summary. K6 is MISSING because there is no mention of the framework-driven development strategy, reusable codebases, or retrofitting features across titles, which are core components of this criterion. The overall coverage is strong with only one major omission, justifying a score of 3 (Generally yes).
